title: character-pack
description: Versioned role-based character pack (schema v2, contributor B owns). Required roles: idle (>=3 clips), work (enter/loop/exit [enter, loop, exit]), neutral_hold (single-clip hold). Optional roles (listen, talk, work_talk, celebrate, question) resolve through fallback_role, ultimately idle. Ownership invariant: question/work_talk actions must be state-owned (model_selectable=false). Asset refs must be bare filenames (no directories, no traversal). License allowlist for public ship is explicit (cleared originals: CC0-1.0 hand-authored vectors and Apache-2.0 owner-approved original Cappi pack); UNRESOLVED/unknown licenses are local-parity-only. Supersedes the draft v0 roles-to-clip-lists shape; v1 Cappi manifests migrate via migrateLegacyManifest to the canonical cappi-original pack with the same role assignments.

pack.description: Stable pack id: lowercase alphanumerics plus . _ -

license.description: Explicit clearance statement. Only allowlisted original licenses (CC0-1.0 hand-authored vectors, Apache-2.0 owner-approved original Cappi pack) ship publicly; values starting with UNRESOLVED — and any other uncleared string — mark local-parity-only packs that must never ship publicly.

roles.description: Required: idle (>=3 clips), work (enter/loop/exit), neutral_hold (hold). Optional (fallback through fallback_role to idle): listen, talk, work_talk, celebrate, question.

transitions.description: Optional explicit graph override: action id -> action id. Both ends must be declared actions.
